agent-manifest.description: The espresso machine: brews and pours a requested drink and reports success or failure. Deterministic hardware service — it makes no judgments about whether a drink should be served; it only brews.

offer.body: Brew and pour the requested drink, returning success or a hardware failure. Makes no decision about whether the drink should be served — that is the barista's promise to keep.
Always reports a brew failure rather than silently producing nothing, so the barista can relay it to the customer.
